description: Public PNG writer overload, scaling, orientation, and safe file-failure contracts. The two source probes target row replication and decoded row order.

mutants.test_filter: Grayscale PNG writer overloads preserve pixels and nearest-neighbor scaling
mutants.description: Only copy one output row per input row despite the scaled dimensions. The independent 2x3-to-4x6 expected pixel matrix detects the missing row replication.

mutants.test_filter: RGB PNG writer overloads preserve channels and decoded row order
mutants.description: Read colored rows in file order rather than the documented bottom-up buffer order. The asymmetric top/middle/bottom RGB rows make the public output mismatch the literal expected pixels.
